segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Hello, Linda speaking.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Oh hi, Linda. This is Matt Brooks. Alex White gave me your number. He said you’d be able to give me some advice about moving to Banford.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Yes, Alex did mention you. How can I help?

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Well, first of all – which area to live in?

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Well, I live in Dalton , which is a really nice suburb – not too expensive, and there’s a nice park.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Sounds good. Do you know how much it would be to rent a two bedroom flat there?

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Yeah, you should be able to get something reasonable for 850 [[ ]] pounds per month. That’s what people typically pay. You certainly wouldn’t want to pay more than 900 pounds. That doesn’t include bills or anything.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: No. That sound alright. I’ll definitely have a look there. Are the transport links easy from where you live?

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Well, I’m very lucky. I work in the city centre so I don’t have to use public transport. I go by bike. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Oh, I wish I could do that. Is it safe to cycle around the city?

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Yes, it’s fine. And it keeps me fit. Anyway, driving to work in the city centre would be a nightmare because there’s hardly any parking [[ ]] . And the traffic during the rush hour can be bad.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: I’d be working from home but I’d have to go to London one or two days a week.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Oh, that’s perfect. Getting to London is no problem. There’s a fast train every 30 minutes [[ ]] which only takes 45 minutes.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: That’s good.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Yeah, the train service isn’t bad during the week. And they run quite late at night. It’s weekends that are a problem [[ ]] . They’re always doing engineering work and you have to take a bus to Hadham and pick up the train there, which is really slow. But other than that, Banford’s a great place to live. I’ve never been happier. ————————

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: There are some nice restaurants in the city centre and a brand new cinema which has only been open a couple of months [[ ]] . There’s a good arts centre too.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Sounds like Banford’s got it all.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Yes! We’re really lucky. There are lots of really good aspects to living here. The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country [[ ]] . Everyone I know who’s been there’s had a positive experience. Oh, I can give you the name of my dentist too in Bridge Street [[ ]] , if you’re interested. I’ve been going to him for years and I’ve never had any problems.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Oh, OK. Thanks!

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: I’ll find his number and send it to you.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Thanks, that would be really helpful.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Are you planning to visit Banford soon?

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Yes. My wife and I are both coming next week. We want to make some appointments with estate agents.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: I could meet you if you like and show you around.

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Are you sure? We’d really appreciate that.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Either a Tuesday or Thursday is good for me, after 5.30. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Thursday’s preferable – Tuesday I need to get home before 6 pm.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: Okay great. Let me know which train your catching and I’ll meet you in the cafe outside. You can’t miss it. It’s opposite the station and next to the museum. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MATT
segments.en: Brilliant. I’ll text you next week then. Thanks so much for all the advice.

segments.speaker: LINDA
segments.en: No problem. I’ll see you next week.
